description: Store catalog with shopInfo (sold/followers/rating) + products priced with sold, rating, typed discount. Costs 2 credits. Empty results and failures are never charged. Pass cache=true for a free 24h cache hit (default always fresh).

cache.description: Set true to serve from the 24h response cache (0 credits on hit). Default false — always fetch fresh. Envelope includes cached + cachedAt on hits.

limit.description: Max items to return (default 20, max 200). Flat 2 credits per call.

region.description: Two-letter market region (default US). Non-US coverage depends on TikTok exposing that shop in the selected region — empty results outside the US are often a platform limit, not a Captapi bug.

url.description: TikTok Shop store URL, e.g. https://www.tiktok.com/shop/store/goli-nutrition/7495794203056835079. The URL platform must match this endpoint's platform. Do not pass cross-platform URLs, e.g. YouTube to TikTok, Instagram to Facebook, LinkedIn to X/Twitter, or Pinterest to Rumble.

name: tiktok_shop_products
title: TikTok Shop Products
